Name: Sweetinsanity9's Portraits
Author: sweetinsanity9
Description:
[center][font=Tahoma]Made a portrait mod- the main vanilla portraits are now done! Just working on some variants ex; beach, seasonal, etc.[/font][/center]
[center]
[size=3]These images are generated using [url=https://pixai.art/]PixAI[/url]﻿ and edited through Photoshop, [url=https://www.canva.com/]Canva[/url]﻿, and [url=https://new.express.adobe.com/]Adobe Express[/url]﻿.[/size]


[color=#cc0000][size=4][b][u]How I made the mod:[/u][/b][/size][/color]

[size=2]I created the images in PixAI then removed the backgrounds with Adobe Express's background remover tool.
If any edits are necessary to be made, I put them in Photoshop to do so ex; if the eye color isn't right, if some parts weren't made transparent, etc.
I then put all of the images, which are saved at 1024x1024 px png format, into Canva on a 2048x4096 px canvas that I divide into 2 columns in rows of 2 to make a portrait sheet of 8 different emotions. Then, I export the portrait sheet as a png with a transparent background from Canva and name it as whatever the NPC's name is that you're creating portraits for. 

To create the XNB file I used the github webtool [url=https://lybell-art.github.io/xnb-js/]XNB Converter[/url]﻿. To do so click the "Pack" button under "Pack XNB" and select the png of your sprite sheet.
It will then convert it to an XNB file you save by clicking the "Download Result" button. Be sure it is named the exact same name as the sprite sheet png you made. [/size]

[size=2]And that's it!~[/size]


[color=#cc0000][size=5][b][u]To install:[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]
- Download the mod Portraiture from here on nexus and add it to your mods folder

- Navigate to the Portraiture mod folder. Go to the Portraits folder and put my mod's folder there. The file pathway should be Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/sweetinsanity9Portraits

- Launch the game. Click on a character with your mouse, once you are talking to them and press "P", whatever options you have for portraits will cycle through as you press it. All you have to do is choose mine.[/size]

[/center]
[center][color=#cc0000][size=4][b][u]FOR THE OPTIONAL DOWNLOADS:[/u][/b][/size][/color]

[size=3]- Same thing as the main file, download the mod Portraiture and add it to your mods folder

- Navigate to the Portraiture mod folder. Go to where you put the main download's files. The file pathway should be Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/sweetinsanity9Portraits[/size]

[size=3]- Copy and paste any of the portraits from the optional files that you want directly into my portrait mod folder. [b]Ensure it is the same portrait folder

[/b]- Launch the game. Click on a character with your mouse, once you are talking to them and press "P", whatever options you have for portraits will cycle through as you press it. All you have to do is choose mine[/size]

[/center]
